name: linkedin-hiring-flow-automation
description: This task automates LinkedIn's hiring flow.  It integrates with the LinkedIn API to extract applicant data (Name, Profile URL, Email, Job Title, etc.) and saves it to an Excel sheet.  It also automates email responses with customizable templates and confirmation prompts before sending each email.  Requires LinkedIn API keys, email service credentials, desired Excel sheet columns, and email template content.

scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && serverless deploy --config serverless.preview.yml
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && serverless deploy --config serverless.prod.yml
